dataset.publisher: City of San Diego Planning via SanGIS
dataset.title: Zoning_Base_SD

semantics.baseZoning: Current base-zone designations from the Official Zoning Map and subsequent updates.
semantics.legalMeaning: No entitlement, standards, density, FAR, height, capacity, or legal conclusion.
semantics.multipleBaseZones: Preserved whenever area evidence is material; no first-zone selection.
semantics.overlayZones: Separate and supplemental to base zoning.
semantics.rawCodes: ZONE_NAME values are preserved verbatim; the layer provides no description field.
semantics.rightsOfWayAndNonparcelCoverage: Not explicitly established by authoritative metadata; unresolved.

sourceDates.featureEffectiveDates: Per-feature imp_date; not a dataset-wide effective date
